$schema_note: Per-model voice baseline scores from VoiceEvaluator gold-set runs. Phase 21 / OPS-508. Refresh whenever a model in the fallback chain changes (provider releases new version, etc.).
methodology: 2. For each entry, generate narration from each fallback model using the same Narrator system prompt (the 7 binding voice constraints from Phase 17)
3. Score each generated narration with VoiceEvaluator
4. Average across 20 entries → per-model baseline score
5. If average < 0.70 (fail band), demote the model in tier_policy.json fallback chain

claude-sonnet-4-6.notes: Reference baseline. Hand-written ideal_narration scores 0.78+ avg; live Sonnet output meets or exceeds in 18/20 entries.

claude-haiku-4-5.notes: Holds voice constraints reasonably well. Marginally weaker on field-journal density (criterion 3) but passes glyph and banned-phrase checks reliably.

kimi-k2.notes: Acceptable as Narrator fallback. Weaker on adjective density (criterion 3) — tends toward more flowery phrasing without heavier prompt constraints. Acceptable for narrative continuity when daily cap is hit.

deepseek-chat.notes: FAILS Narrator-tier baseline by 0.01. Acceptable for validators (which don't produce player-facing prose) and voice_evaluator (heuristic only) but should NOT serve as Narrator fallback in current state. Mitigation paths: (a) extend prompt with stricter voice constraints; (b) demote from premium chain entirely. Current tier_policy.json places it third in premium chain only as last-resort canned fallback follows after.
deepseek-chat.follow_up: If repeatedly seen as Narrator selection, extend Narrator system prompt with explicit deepseek-targeted constraints OR remove from premium fallback chain.

mistral-medium-2.notes: Better voice fidelity than DeepSeek but slightly worse than Kimi. Pass band for cheap tier. Acceptable as Narrator fallback only when Kimi and DeepSeek both fail.

tier_chain_recommendation.premium: claude-sonnet-4-6 → kimi-k2 → (graceful canned fallback). Removed deepseek-chat from premium chain pending prompt tightening.

discipline_notes: VoiceEvaluator scores measured here are heuristic, not ground truth. If a fallback model passes the heuristic but produces visibly worse voice in playtest, override by changing tier_policy.json directly — heuristic is guidance, not gospel.
When refreshing this file: increment last_run_iso, document any model removals from tier chains, and run npm run voice:eval to confirm gold-set still passes against the new chain.
DO NOT remove the canned 'world pauses' graceful fallback from throttle.ts. It is the final safety net when all model fallbacks fail.
